title: One access-machine transition
statement: Let $y$ be a Boolean word, $c$ a configuration, and $st$ an access state. If the state of $c$ is $st$ and every work-tape head position of $c$ lies between $-1$ and $|\mathrm{bits}(|y|+1)|$, inclusive, then there is a finite safe computation path from $c$ to the configuration obtained by applying the access-machine transition for mode and state $st$ to $c$.
hypotheses_covered: the state of c is st
all work-tape head positions are in $[-1,|\mathrm{bits}(|y|+1)|]$
